key.name: unit
key.description: Unit used for displayed temperatures. “auto” follows the locale (Fahrenheit where customary), otherwise Celsius.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often fresh weather is requested when conditions allow. Minimum 10 minutes to stay polite to the provider.

key.name: location-mode
key.description: “auto” uses GNOME location services (GeoClue) with the system permission dialog; “manual” uses the city chosen in preferences.

key.name: manual-name
key.summary: Name of the manually chosen location
key.description: Display name of the city picked via search, e.g. “Berlin”.

key.name: manual-latitude
key.summary: Latitude of the manually chosen location
key.description: Stored rounded to two decimals (about 1 km).

key.name: manual-longitude
key.summary: Longitude of the manually chosen location
key.description: Stored rounded to two decimals (about 1 km).

key.name: auto-latitude
key.summary: Last known latitude from location services
key.description: Rounded to two decimals. Kept only so the widget does not need to ask location services again on every login. Never leaves this machine except in weather requests to Open-Meteo.

key.name: auto-longitude
key.summary: Last known longitude from location services
key.description: Rounded to two decimals. Kept only so the widget does not need to ask location services again on every login. Never leaves this machine except in weather requests to Open-Meteo.

key.name: card-x
key.description: Stage coordinates in points. -1 means “use the default position”.

key.name: card-y
key.description: Stage coordinates in points. -1 means “use the default position”.
